message.content:
Decorative aluminum lion statue: the candidates are heading 8306 (statuettes and other ornaments of base metal) or 7616 (other articles of aluminum). Heading 8306 covers statuettes and other ornaments, and its subheading 8306.29 covers "other" ornaments (not plated with precious metal). The statue is large, but it is still a decorative ornament. Chapter 76 does not exclude it, though Note 1 to Chapter 83 and the Section XV notes place such ornaments in 8306 rather than 7616.

The relevant 10-digit line is 8306.29.00 (statuettes and other ornaments, other). Its statistical suffix is 8306.29.0000.

Chapter 83 covers base-metal ornaments, and Section XV Note 1(g) excludes only certain items, not statues. Customs rulings on large aluminum sculptures, such as animal statues, have classified them in 8306.29.0000.
